import { expect, test } from 'vitest';
import { api, internal } from '../../convex/_generated/api';
import { backend, table } from './fixtures/table';
import { GOBLIN_WARRIOR_ID } from '../../convex/lib/foeSource';

test('review: hidden difficulty does not collide with literal skill text', async () => {
  const t = backend();
  const { player, observer, campaignId } = await table(t);
  const result = await player.client.mutation(api.commands.submit, {
    campaignId, commandId: 'review-skill-collision',
    text: '@Thorn /test roll characteristic=M value=2 skill="Lore; hard: winter" difficulty=hard',
  });
  const event = (await observer.client.query(api.events.list, { campaignId })).events.find(e => e.id === result.eventId)!;
  expect(event.description).toContain('(Lore; hard: winter)');
  expect(event.description).not.toMatch(/; hard: (?:success|failure)/i);
});

test('review: closed session cursor retains projection, source endpoints deny peers, registered foes work between sessions', async () => {
  const t = backend();
  const { director, player, observer, campaignId, sessionId, thornId } = await table(t);
  await t.mutation(internal.content.reseed, {});
  const foeId = await director.client.mutation(api.foes.add, {
    campaignId, definitionId: GOBLIN_WARRIOR_ID, commandId: 'review-add-foe',
  });
  const hidden = await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit, {
    campaignId, commandId: 'review-negative-health', text: `@{foe:${foeId}} /adjust stamina value=-11`,
  });
  const testResult = await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit, {
    campaignId, commandId: 'review-recorded-test', text: '@Thorn /test roll characteristic=M value=2 difficulty=medium',
  });
  await director.client.mutation(api.sessions.transition, {
    sessionId: sessionId!, expectedRevision: 0, action: 'close', commandId: 'review-close-session',
  });
  for (const client of [player.client, observer.client]) {
    await expect(client.query(api.foes.catalog, { campaignId })).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(client.query(api.foes.detail, { campaignId, foeId })).rejects.toThrow();
    if (client === observer.client) await expect(client.query(api.characters.get, { characterId: thornId })).rejects.toThrow();
    const rows = (await client.query(api.events.list, { campaignId, sessionId: sessionId!, before: testResult.sequence + 1 })).events;
    expect(rows.find(e => e.id === hidden.eventId)!.description).not.toContain('-11');
    expect(rows.find(e => e.id === testResult.eventId)!.payload.data.result).not.toHaveProperty('difficulty');
  }
  await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit, {
    campaignId, commandId: 'review-show-old-test', text: '/campaign test-difficulty-visible state=on',
  });
  const rows = (await observer.client.query(api.events.list, { campaignId, sessionId: sessionId! })).events;
  expect(rows.find(e => e.id === testResult.eventId)!.payload.data.result.difficulty).toBe('medium');
  await director.client.mutation(api.commands.submit, {
    campaignId, commandId: 'review-remove-between', text: `@{foe:${foeId}} /foe remove`,
  });
  expect(await t.run(ctx => ctx.db.get(foeId))).toBeNull();
});
